# Spatial bottleneck modulation - smooth transition in road capacity
    bottleneck = 1 + params[2] * np.tanh(x * params[3])
    
    # Traffic conservation with bottleneck (Greenshields flux)
    flux = u * (1 - u) * bottleneck
    advection = -d_dx(flux, order=1)
    
    # Anticipation-driven relative gradient diffusion
    # Drivers respond to relative density changes (normalized by local density)
    relative_gradient = u / (1 + u)
    anticipation_diffusion = params[0] * d_dx(relative_gradient, order=2)
    
    # Simple diffusion as baseline
    simple_diffusion = params[1] * d_dx(u, order=2)
    
    # Combine physical terms with optimized weights
    u_t_pred = advection + anticipation_diffusion + simple_diffusion
    
    return u_t_pred
